prose: Reuters' Toby Sterling reports that NADI, a new Dutch government agency set up in the style of DARPA to pursue strategic innovation, has launched a 40 million euro challenge to accelerate chip design with AI, in collaboration with its German counterpart SPRIND.
highlights: NADI, a DARPA-like Dutch agency, launches a 40M euro AI chip-design challenge.
The effort is run with Germany's SPRIND.
Reported by Toby Sterling for Reuters.
